description: Densité des citernes DFCI HBE dans le département du Var is a dataset listed in Geocatalogue France, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by BUREAU DE RECHERCHES GÉOLOGIQUES ET MINIÈRES. Number of HBE tanks per DFCI tile (2x2 km), in the Var department. Coverage: FR. The portal shows the English title as "Density of DFCI HBE tanks in the department of Var" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include hbe;citerne ; remocra:DFCI. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-geocatalogue-fr.
